verdict.rationale: Perplexity's 'Computer' feature is documented as a full cloud browser agent that can browse the web, fill forms, and access login-gated content on the user's behalf (perplexity-docs-17/18/29/30), matching the story closely. However, hands-on community reporting says the Computer research feature 'often fails to trigger via the UI, and when it does work, sessions frequently stall without returning an answer' (perplexity-comm-7), directly contradicting reliable agentic browsing. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of successful end-to-end task completion, and resolution of the reported reliability failures.
